title: Manhattan classics
description: From the bridge to the park: four spots every New Yorker knows. Drop a bugg at each to earn the badge.

spots.name: Brooklyn Bridge
spots.why: Walk out from the Manhattan side for the skyline behind you.

spots.name: Washington Square Park
spots.why: Musicians, chess players and the arch, any time of day.

spots.name: Times Square
spots.why: Brightest after dark. Stand on the red steps for the full view.

spots.name: Bethesda Terrace
spots.why: The fountain, the arcade and buskers in the heart of Central Park.
